description: Shared Renovate preset of {{owner}}: Renovate updates every ecosystem, GitHub Actions included, and merges non-major updates itself as its App, which is exempt from the main-human-gates ruleset (see the repo-init skill, references/renovate.md).

packageRules.description: config:recommended's :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers would title every update chore(deps): restore build(deps) as the default. The fix(deps) rule below still wins for what ships.
Non-major updates merge on their own once the required checks pass.
Majors wait for a person, who reads the release notes.
A dependency that ships inside the package releases a patch.
Docker and GHCR images publish no release timestamp outside Docker Hub: do not hold them forever.
